Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Consistent-mass FEM string eigenpairs Consistent-mass P1 string eigenpairs compare an M-inner-product Krylov method and actual SciPy LOBPCG with an independent discrete spectrum. Assumptions, units and boundaries A unit string with unit tension and density and homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints. Use 15, 31 and 63 interior nodes and the lowest three eigenpairs. Editorial clarification A small 1D string only. If SciPy raises before returning, inputs are retained; unreturned internal iterates are not claimed to be saved. The 35 component checks do not replace the four full scientific cases. Adopted numerical method Elementwise K and M assembly, M-inner-product Krylov iteration on K^-1 M, and actual SciPy LOBPCG with a small exact-K-inverse preconditioner. LOBPCG starts from {1, x^3, x^6}; degree-plus-two images avoid the structural rank defect of {1, x, x^2}. The same M is applied through a qualified einsum LinearOperator, avoiding the dense-B adapter. The eigensolver itself remains SciPy LOBPCG.
